    Beef

    Cottage Pie

    The kind of dinner that makes a cold night feel cosy. A rich beef, carrot, pea and corn filling under buttery mash, finished with a blanket of melted mozzarella and Parmesan, all made and baked in one ovenproof pan.

    Serves 4Prep 10 minCook 45 min

    Chicken

    Roast Chicken

    A Sunday roast chicken brings everyone to the table without being called. Lemon, garlic and thyme butter is pushed under the skin, then the bird is trussed and roasted to temperature for crackling-crisp skin and breast meat that's still juicy. Save the pan juices for the gravy.

    Serves 4Prep 20 minCook about 1 hr 15 min
    Sunday roast

    Desserts

    Trifle

    Our family classic, and the dessert everyone waits for at Christmas. Based on Jamie Oliver's retro trifle, it's layer upon layer of jam roll, strawberries and Cointreau, strawberry jelly, blancmange, mandarins, orange jelly, custard and cream. It needs time for each layer to set, so make it the day before.

    Serves 12
    ChristmasMake ahead

    Pork

    Toad in the Hole

    Pure comfort: sausages baked into a tall, golden Yorkshire pudding that puffs up around them in the oven, served with a jug of onion gravy. A spoonful of mayonnaise in the batter is the secret to a pudding that rises higher and collapses less.

    Serves 4Prep 15 minCook 40 min

    Potatoes

    Baked Potato

    A baked potato with a crisp, salty skin and a fluffy middle is one of life's simple pleasures. These are baked in foil until soft, crisped with olive oil and salt, then quartered and piled high with whatever toppings you love.

    Serves 4Cook 1 hr 45–50 min
    Vegetarian

    Sides

    Duck Fat Potatoes

    The potatoes everyone fights over at Christmas and Sunday roasts. Parboiled, roughed up so the edges go fluffy, then roasted in smoking-hot duck fat until they shatter when you bite in. Adapted by RecipeTin Eats from Nigella Lawson's goose fat potatoes.

    Serves 6–8Prep 15 minCook 1 hr 15 min
    ChristmasSunday roast

    Gravy

    No roast is finished until the gravy jug goes round. This one is made in minutes from the Roast Chicken's pan juices, thickened with Gravox. Makes about 1 cup.

    Serves 4
    Sunday roast
